title: Wool
author: Hugh Howey
summary: Thousands of survivors live in an underground silo, forbidden to go outside because the air above is toxic. When the sheriff chooses to leave, a mechanic is pulled into a hunt for what really happened.
readIf: you like claustrophobic dystopias with a mystery built into the structure.
skipIf: you want a standalone; the series continues, and some questions stay open until later volumes.

pairings.reason: Another story of a closed society built on a lie, with a heroine who pushes against it.
A quieter and more reflective take on life after collapse, with a focus on culture and memory.
A short, classic dystopia about a society that hides the truth and a person who starts to question it.
